nodes.description: Public token name string, set once in the constructor to 'Shihtzu Inu'.
Public token symbol string, set once in the constructor to 'Shihtzu Inu'.
Public uint8 token decimals, initialised to 9.
Private hardcoded privileged address (0x8799CD...) that gates the transferFrom logic.
Public uint256 total supply, minted to the deployer in the constructor.
Mapping(address => uint) holding every account balance.
Nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) holding ERC-20 allowances.
Deployment constructor: sets metadata, mints the whole supply to msg.sender and emits Transfer.
Returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)].
Returns the balance of a given token owner.
Returns the remaining allowance a spender has over a token owner.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emits Approval.
Moves tokens from msg.sender to a recipient using safeSub/safeAdd balance updates.
Transfers tokens on behalf of 'from'; behaviour is gated on from == _owner and is a no-op otherwise.
SafeMath addition with an overflow require.
SafeMath subtraction with an underflow require.
SafeMath multiplication with an overflow require.
SafeMath division guarded against division by zero.
Caller-controlled address used for minting, approvals, debits and allowance ownership.
Authorization branch that only performs a real transfer when from == _owner; all other callers are silently ignored.
Else branch of transferFrom that writes balances/allowed with a zero delta, performing no real transfer while returning true.
Balance arithmetic in transfer/transferFrom relying on SafeMath helper calls for overflow/underflow protection.
Address parameter of balanceOf whose balance is looked up.
Address parameter of allowance identifying the allowance owner.
Address parameter of allowance identifying the spender.
Address parameter of approve that receives the allowance.
Amount parameter of approve stored as the allowance value.
Recipient address parameter of transfer.
Amount parameter of transfer credited to the recipient.
Source address parameter of transferFrom, compared against _owner.
Recipient address parameter of transferFrom.
Amount parameter of transferFrom moved from the source.
First operand of safeAdd.
Second operand of safeAdd.
First operand of safeSub.
Second operand of safeSub.
First operand of safeMul.
Second operand of safeMul.
First operand of safeDiv.
Second operand of safeDiv (denominator).
Named return variable holding the queried balance.
Named return variable holding the remaining allowance.
Named return flag of approve.
Named return flag of transfer.
Named return flag of transferFrom.
Named return variable holding the safeAdd result.
Named return variable holding the safeSub result.
Named return variable holding the safeMul result.
Named return variable holding the safeDiv result.
